changes.name: CrystalExpansionTest
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")

-- TEMP TEST SETTINGS: every orb is worth 1,000,000 and expansion costs display as 1.
local function hookOrb(orb)
 if not orb:IsA("BasePart") or orb.Name~="EnergyOrb" then return end
 local done=false
 orb.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
  if done or not orb.Parent then return end
  local player=Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
  if not player then return end
  local energy=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and player.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Energy")
  if not energy then return end
  done=true
  -- Main game already awards 1; add the remainder.
  energy.Value+=999999
 end)
end
for _,v in ipairs(world:GetChildren()) do hookOrb(v) end
world.ChildAdded:Connect(function(v) task.wait();hookOrb(v) end)

-- Make existing expansion prompts effectively cost 1 by refunding the old price difference
-- after a successful stage change.
local oldStages={}
local oldEnergy={}
local refunds={9,29,69,139}
local function hookPlayer(p)
 local stage=p:WaitForChild("IslandStage")
 local energy=p:WaitForChild("leaderstats"):WaitForChild("Energy")
 oldStages[p]=stage.Value
 oldEnergy[p]=energy.Value
 stage:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
  local before=oldStages[p] or 0
  local after=stage.Value
  if after>before then
   local refund=refunds[after]
   if refund then energy.Value+=refund end
  end
  oldStages[p]=after
 end)
end
for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(hookPlayer,p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hookPlayer)

-- Crystal biome for Expansion 2.
local crystalFolder=Instance.new("Folder")
crystalFolder.Name="CrystalExpansionDecor"
crystalFolder.Parent=world
local crystals={}
local function crystal(x,z,h,color)
 local p=Instance.new("Part")
 p.Name="Crystal"
 p.Size=Vector3.new(2.2,h,2.2)
 p.Position=Vector3.new(x,20+h/2,z)
 p.Orientation=Vector3.new(math.random(-10,10),math.random(0,180),math.random(-10,10))
 p.Anchored=true
 p.CanCollide=false
 p.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
 p.Color=color
 p.Transparency=1
 p.Parent=crystalFolder
 local light=Instance.new("PointLight");light.Color=color;light.Brightness=1.5;light.Range=9;light.Parent=p
 table.insert(crystals,p)
end
local blue=Color3.fromRGB(85,175,255)
local purple=Color3.fromRGB(180,95,255)
crystal(-42,-13,7,blue);crystal(-34,-2,5,purple);crystal(-43,2,4,blue);crystal(-32,-14,6,purple);crystal(-48,-4,5,blue)

local expansion=world:WaitForChild("Expansion2")
task.spawn(function()
 while world.Parent do
  if expansion.Transparency<1 then
   for i,p in ipairs(crystals) do
    task.delay(i*.08,function()
     if p.Parent then TweenService:Create(p,TweenInfo.new(.35),{Transparency=0}):Play() end
    end)
   end
   break
  end
  task.wait(.15)
 end
end)

print("Crystal expansion test settings loaded")
